lines.zh: 我沿着浅水走，长嘴几乎贴到水面。
lines.en: I walk the shallows, long snout almost on the water.

lines.zh: 脚掌踩进河泥，水花不高。
lines.en: My feet sink into river mud with barely a splash.
One sweep of my tail parts the duckweed.
I slow and stretch my neck forward.
There is fish in this bend; I come here often.

lines.zh: 我走过芦苇，它们比我还高。
lines.en: I pass through reeds taller than I am.

lines.zh: 一只青蛙跳开，我看了看，没追。
lines.en: A frog leaps off; I look, and let it go.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，贴着岸边走。
lines.en: I keep low and hug the bank.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留下三道痕。
lines.en: My claws leave three furrows in the ground.

lines.zh: 水流推着我的腿，我站得很稳。
lines.en: The current pushes my legs; I stand firm.
I cut diagonally across a run of fast water.

lines.zh: 前面有块石头，我一步跨上去。
lines.en: A boulder ahead; I step up onto it.
I glance back at the way I came.

lines.zh: 走水边不费劲，我喜欢这样。
lines.en: Walking the waterline is easy; I like it.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，让水从腿上流过。
lines.en: I stand still and let the water pass my legs.
My snout tip just touches the surface.
I am waiting for the fish to come to me.
Sunlight burns the river white.
I narrow my eyes; the water is too bright.

lines.zh: 一只蜻蜓落在我鼻梁上，我没动。
lines.en: A dragonfly lands on my snout; I do not move.
A low sound rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，抖了抖泥。
lines.en: I lift a foot and shake off the mud.

lines.zh: 对岸有影子，可能是别的什么。
lines.en: A shape on the far bank; maybe something else.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像根倒下的木头。
lines.en: I stay still as a fallen log.
Something is turning the sand underwater.
I curl my tail around my feet.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味吹向下游。
lines.en: The wind carries my scent downstream.
Patience is what the river taught me.
Crouched on the bank — I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 鳄鱼嘴一样的吻，等那条鱼。
lines.en: This crocodile snout waits for that fish.
I take my time and look first.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，像一块石头。
lines.en: You crouch at the bank like a stone.

lines.zh: 你比我记忆里的猎物高。
lines.en: You stand taller than the prey I remember.
If you reach out, I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我记得给我喂过东西的那张脸。
lines.en: I remember the face that fed me.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很长，但咬得不轻率。
lines.en: My snout is long, but I do not bite rashly.
Where you stand, the fish will avoid.

lines.zh: 我低声应了一下，算是招呼。
lines.en: I answer low, which is my greeting.
Will you come into the water with me?

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽动，闻你的口袋。
lines.en: My nose twitches at your pockets.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔一开一合，闻你的口袋。
lines.en: My nostrils flare, reading your pockets.

lines.zh: 岸边这块地方，我让给你一半。
lines.en: Half this stretch of bank is yours.
Why do you smile? I do not understand it.
This crocodile mouth is made for catching fish.
I hiss and retreat into the water.
A plate of scales is torn from my side.
I lower my long snout.
My legs feel weak; I hold still.
I turn a circle in the water.
It hurts, but not enough to drop me.
I breathe out something that tastes of blood.
Scales scraped off my back.
I back away behind the reeds.
I will remember this.
The smell of fish lifts my head.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I come toward you with light steps.
Set it down; I will not snatch.
This one I will eat on dry land.
I open and take it, then close again.
That was small. Is there more?

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼味走了半条河岸。
lines.en: I followed the smell half the bank.

lines.zh: 水里的鱼我也抓得到，但这个省事。
lines.en: I can catch fish myself, but this is easier.
Two bites and it is gone.
I lick the water from my jaw.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的脖子。
lines.en: Your shoulder bumps my neck.

lines.zh: 我让开，尾巴扫起一片水。
lines.en: I step aside and my tail sprays water.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，你退得比我快。
lines.en: We knock; you back off faster than I do.
Do not stand where I turn.

lines.zh: 我低下身，从你旁边挤过去。
lines.en: I duck low and squeeze past you.
I slip on the wet ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴是有点占地方。
lines.en: My tail does take up room.
Bumping me will not hurt me, but it may hurt you.

lines.zh: 你退后，我先把路让出来。
lines.en: Step back; I will clear the way first.
Next time take my left; there is space there.
She is on the far bank; I swim over.
I push the fish I just caught toward her.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也没动。
lines.en: We stand side by side and neither moves.

lines.zh: 我的长嘴碰了碰她的脖子。
lines.en: My long snout touches her neck.
I have trampled a nest flat by the river.

lines.zh: 这一带水浅，适合养小崽子。
lines.en: The water is shallow here, good for young.

lines.zh: 她走一步，我跟着走一步。
lines.en: She takes a step; I take one.
We lower our heads to drink together.

lines.zh: 尾巴交在一起，很快就分开。
lines.en: Our tails cross, then part.

lines.zh: 她走时尾巴在水面划一道。
lines.en: As she leaves, her tail cuts a line across the water.
I bite it and shake my head.
This thing sinks in water.

lines.zh: 钩爪勾住它，我提起来看。
lines.en: My hooked claw snags it; I lift it up to look.
Not fish; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我把它叼到石头上放好。
lines.en: I carry it to a stone and set it there.
Wet and slick; hard to hold.
I swim a short way with it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 水里掉的东西我都能捞。
lines.en: I can fish up anything dropped in water.
This one has some weight.

lines.zh: 我把嘴里的东西交给你。
lines.en: I give you what is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 水里那条大鱼我盯上了。
lines.en: I have my eye on that big fish.
I lower my head, aimed at the surface.
Something is walking the shallows.
I hear the flapping.

lines.zh: 这个不是鱼，但也吃得下。
lines.en: This is no fish, but it will do.

lines.zh: 我慢慢调转身体，面向它。
lines.en: I turn my body slowly to face it.

lines.zh: 我把背脊沉到水下，只露眼。
lines.en: I sink my spine under the water, eyes only.
My claws grip the bank first.
I have been ready for this for a while.
The scent is strong; it will not get away.

lines.zh: 我把长嘴抬起来，又落下。
lines.en: I raise the long snout, then bring it down.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的眼睛跟着它。
lines.en: It moves, and my eyes follow.
The moment the surface breaks, I charge.
It is alone in this bend.
I track along the bank, unhurried.
It heads deeper; I enter the water.

lines.zh: 我的头一直朝着那个方向。
lines.en: My head stays turned that way.
It rounds the rock; so do I.
The water masks my steps.

lines.zh: 它一停住，我就再挪半步。
lines.en: When it halts, I shift half a step nearer.

lines.zh: 我压低长吻，水只到膝盖。
lines.en: I lower my long snout; the water is only knee-deep.

lines.zh: 它已经在我嘴里够得到的地方。
lines.en: It is nearly within reach of my jaws.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，堵住去路。
lines.en: I turn broadside and cut off its path.
My tail sways gently to steady me.

lines.zh: 它一转头，我的爪子先落地。
lines.en: It turns its head; my claw touches down first.
Only two paces of water lie between us.
My long snout is made for fishing.
It is panting fast; I can hear it.
I know this path; it does not.
My long jaws snap shut.

lines.zh: 它被甩起来，又摔回水里。
lines.en: It is flung up and crashes back into the water.

lines.zh: 长吻一合，水从缝里喷出来。
lines.en: The long jaws close and water squirts from the seam.
I bite down on the thick part and hold.
Thrashing in the water ruins my table manners.
I shake my head side to side and drag it down.
The riverbed mud churns up.

lines.zh: 它挣开了一次，我又扑上。
lines.en: It breaks free once; I lunge again.
That will be remembered.

lines.zh: 我喘了口气，嘴里还有味。
lines.en: I catch my breath; the taste lingers.
I hold the catch down at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 鳄鱼嘴合上了，水里安静。
lines.en: The crocodile jaws closed. The water's quiet.

lines.zh: 牙齿碰骨头的声音很闷。
lines.en: Teeth on bone make a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，看它还动不。
lines.en: I step back to see if it still moves.

lines.zh: 河岸的鱼，我一低头就够。
lines.en: Fish by the bank, right under my snout.
I shake the water from my back.
The river is narrower than I remember.
I sniff the mud on the bank.
A fish jumps far off; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇里走出来，慢慢看清。
lines.en: I step out of the reeds and look around.
This water is new ground.
I test the depth first.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩进软泥，很深。
lines.en: My claws sink deep into soft mud.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的河，和这条不太一样。
lines.en: The Cretaceous river was not quite like this one.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘了口气，全是水味。
lines.en: I open my jaws and breathe water-smell.
I crouch and lie low a while.
The sun is high; the river shines.

lines.zh: 我要找一段安静的浅滩。
lines.en: I need a quiet stretch of shallows.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我转身沿河走。
lines.en: One tail sweep, and I turn upriver.
I am learning the smells here.
Frogs, fish, enough for me.
I will walk a way and learn this river.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的鳍，我掉头扎进水里。
lines.en: Fire catches my fin; I turn and plunge in.

lines.zh: 我从岸坡滚下去，摔在石滩上。
lines.en: I tumble down the bank onto the stones.

lines.zh: 我呛了一口，脖子拼命往上伸。
lines.en: I choke and strain my neck upward.

lines.zh: 冲击把我从水面掀到岸上。
lines.en: The blast throws me from the water onto the bank.
An arrow sticks in my neck.

lines.zh: 紫色的光缠住我的嘴，我合不上。
lines.en: Violet light binds my jaws so I cannot close them.

lines.zh: 河里的鱼都没了，我的肚子在叫。
lines.en: The fish are gone; my belly is growling.
Lightning hits the river and the water goes numb.

lines.zh: 河床忽然空了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The riverbed vanishes and I fall.
